summary: 2 of 3 checks FAIL. Blocking issues: (1) teacher.role value 'teacher' in schema does not match 'profesor' used by transcript/CLAUDE.md — all role-based access control is broken; (2) teacher_module has no UNIQUE(module_id) constraint — transcript requires each module taught by exactly one teacher; (3) teacher table has no must_change_password boolean — first-login forced password-change flow cannot be reliably implemented.

issues.description: Transcripcion describes two filter groups ('Filtrar por proyecto' and 'Filtrar por alumno') but only assigns explicit IDs to the project-side filters (#73–#77). Student-side filter IDs #78–#82 are referenced only implicitly. Behavior is covered, IDs are not tagged.

Element #97 (delete icon in the 'Nuevo item' table row) is present in boceto HTML but is not referenced by number in transcripcion. Its existence is implied by the edit/delete pattern described for all tables.

ui-spec.json role_guard values are ['admin', 'profesor', 'tutor'], matching CLAUDE.md domain vocabulary. Schema CHECK constraint is `role IN ('admin', 'teacher', 'tutor')`. The value 'profesor' is never valid in schema — any RBAC check against the DB will silently fail for all professor accounts.

Transcripcion states 'Cada módulo será impartido por un único profesor' (one teacher per module). Schema table teacher_module(teacher_id, module_id) has PRIMARY KEY (teacher_id, module_id) but no UNIQUE(module_id) — multiple teachers can be assigned to the same module. The uniqueness invariant is not enforced at DB level.

Transcript consistently uses rol = 'profesor' (sections: Roles del sistema, login, profesorado). Schema CHECK: role IN ('admin', 'teacher', 'tutor'). Value 'profesor' is not in the allowed set. Required fix: change CHECK to role IN ('admin', 'profesor', 'tutor').

Transcript: 'Cada módulo será impartido por un único profesor.' Schema teacher_module has no UNIQUE(module_id). Required fix: add UNIQUE(module_id) to teacher_module. Note: this also implies teacher_module should track the current assignment (one row per module), not a many-to-many history.

Transcript: 'Cuando un profesor o administrador inicie sesión por primera vez, deberá cambiar su contraseña obligatoriamente.' Schema teacher table has no must_change_password BOOLEAN or equivalent column. Without it, the application cannot reliably detect a first login — comparing against a hardcoded default hash is fragile and insecure. Required fix: add must_change_password BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE to teacher.
Transcript: 'La contraseña por defecto será 12345678.' Schema seed inserts admin with password 'changeme'. Required fix: update seed INSERT to use '12345678' as the default password (bcrypt hashed).

Transcript states 'Un ciclo es únicamente un nombre. No lleva legislación asociada directamente. La legislación se asocia a los módulos, no al ciclo.' However, schema has cycle.legislation_id INT NOT NULL — and the UI cascading-selector flow described in the same transcript (legislación → año → ciclos) requires exactly this FK to filter cycles by legislation. CLAUDE.md also states 'Ciclo: name, linked to legislación'. The transcript prose is internally inconsistent. Schema and CLAUDE.md are aligned; the prose statement in the transcript should be corrected to reflect the actual data model.

Transcript: 'La suma máxima de una rúbrica no puede superar 10 puntos.' No DB-level CHECK on the sum of rubric_level.score values per rubric. Enforcement is application-level only. Acceptable by design — complex aggregate constraints are typically handled in the service layer.

Transcript: maximum 3 failed login attempts before account lockout. Schema teacher table has no failed_attempts INT or account_locked BOOLEAN columns. Without DB persistence, failed-attempt counters are lost on server restart. Recommended: add failed_login_attempts SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 and account_locked BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE to teacher.

blocking_issues.fix: schema.sql: change teacher CHECK from role IN ('admin', 'teacher', 'tutor') to role IN ('admin', 'profesor', 'tutor'). Update seed INSERT and trigger trg_max_tutors_per_cycle accordingly.
schema.sql: add UNIQUE(module_id) to teacher_module. Decide whether to keep the composite PK or replace with a simpler unique module FK pattern.
schema.sql: add must_change_password BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE to teacher table.

recommended_fixes.fix: schema.sql: update seed password from 'changeme' to '12345678' (bcrypt hashed).
schema.sql: add failed_login_attempts SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 and account_locked BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE to teacher.
transcripcion.md: correct the prose in the Ciclos section — acknowledge that cycle carries legislation_id (FK) as a data-model design decision required by the cascading UI filter flow.
